description: Runs Foundry Virtual Tabletop headlessly in Docker, with a browser-based game server, world data, modules, and assets. Requires a Foundry license but no external database.
author: WisdomSky

tips.before_install: Requires a purchased FoundryVTT license. Set `FOUNDRY_USERNAME`, `FOUNDRY_PASSWORD`, `FOUNDRY_ADMIN_KEY`, and optionally `FOUNDRY_LICENSE_KEY` in the app settings. The stable hostname is required for license activation.

title: FoundryVTT
